description:
The Embassy of the United States of America in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia has a requirement for the acquisition of Landscape Care and Maintenance Services at the United States Embassy. U.S. Embassy Riyadh is located within the Diplomatic Quarter at Abdullah Ibn Hudhafah Al-Shami Street at Roundabout No. 9.

Scope of Contract:   The Contractor shall provide Landscape Care and Maintenance Service to the United States Embassy in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The anticipated performance period is for one base year, with four one-year option periods, if exercised by the Government.  All responsible sources may submit a proposal electronically to  RiyadhContracting@state.gov. 

Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. When the solicitation is available, the Embassy of the United States in Saudi Arabia will post this solicitation on the System for Award Management’s (SAM) website at https://www.sam.gov.

The Government intends to award a contract which meets all the solicitation requirements to the lowest priced, technically acceptable offeror.  The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a firm fixed-price type contract.

The Government is planning a pre-proposal conference and the date for this conference will be in the solicitation.  

All Contractors must be registered in SAM prior to submission of proposal pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7.  Prospective offerors are encouraged to register prior to the submittal of proposals. 

The guidelines for registration in SAM are also available at:
https://common.usembassy.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/130/2023/07/Quick-Start-Guide-for-International-Registrations-1.pdf, and https://common.usembassy.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/130/2023/07/Entity-checklist.pdf.
